purpose: Separate retrospective chronological evaluation of four new Signal catalog sources; not a change to the existing six-hour 63-source protocol.

candidates.name: r-laguerre
candidates.label: Laguerre RSI turn
candidates.calculation: Existing research3 laguerreRsi recurrence and level-reentry onsets unchanged; RSI thresholds are system adaptations.

candidates.name: r-chand
candidates.label: ATR Chandelier channel flip
candidates.calculation: Existing research3 previous-bar rolling high/low plus/minus ATR channel flip unchanged; differs from a since-entry trade stop.

candidates.name: r-klinger
candidates.label: Klinger volume-force cross
candidates.calculation: Existing research3 cumulative volume-force abs(2*dm/cm-1) variant and sign-aligned signal-line crosses unchanged; platform conventions vary.

candidates.name: r-rvi
candidates.label: Relative Vigor Index cross
candidates.calculation: Four-bar 1,2,2,1 weighted close-open and high-low, period sums ratio, symmetric four-bar signal line; upward cross with positive RVI long, downward cross with negative RVI short.

data.existingUse: This public cache has previously been used for Tactic research. The new source formulas have not been scored here. This is retrospective chronological holdout evidence, not an untouched global or forward sample.

protectionPolicy: Exact runtime signalProtects and laneProtect scaling: Normal 15, capped Normal+Trailing 15, no-target Trailing-only 9. No derived historical MFE configs in this fixed-grid comparison.

model.entry: Current DEFAULT_TACTICS via entrySignal(follow); completed-bar signals enter next open; current cooldown; opposite directions simulated independently.
model.capital: Independent configuration research, without portfolio/account coordination or live fills. No account profit or live execution PF claim.

selection.group: Exact source/range/lane/type/protection/direction config; preserve all cells, including losses, unknowns and no-loss provenance.
selection.policy: Physically truncate IS data before calculation. Freeze every IS-qualified config-side identity before reading OOS summaries. Evaluate the full selected pool, not an OOS-selected winner; publish all-config diagnostics separately. Fresh OOS positions with pre-context; endpoint marks separately retained.

promotion: Research candidates remain default-disabled. No automatic live promotion, threshold changes, symbol replacement or post-OOS retuning.
